0022600103.text: The Kings (0-1, fourth in the Pacific and 14th in the West) host the Trail Blazers (1-0, first in the Northwest and first in the West) in Sacramento's second game of the 2026-27 season, after a loss in their opener. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, ruptured), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and is a game-time decision. Portland is missing Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), with Branden Carlson (concussion) and Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) both day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Kings lost all four meetings with Portland in 2025-26, most recently 122-110 in Portland on April 12, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
